name: Cornbread II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1¼ cup (310 ml / 10 oz) mixture of milk and orange juice (you can use as much orange juice as you like; ¼–½ cup (60–125 ml / 2–4.2 oz) is ideal)
⅓ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) white granulated sugar
¼ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) vegetable oil

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (205°C). Grease a 20 cm baking pan.
Combine cornmeal and milk/orange juice, and let stand 10 minutes.
Add egg and oil to cornmeal mixture, then add dry ingredients. Stir until combined.
Pour the mixture into the baking pan.
